body.title: ci: make DCO advisory and run workflows on PR synchronize
body.body:
## Summary
- make DCO check advisory (non-blocking) so missing sign-offs don't fail PRs
- ensure PR triggers for core workflows
- add PR-safe validation paths for release/stale/reminder workflows

## Why
- current DCO failures are blocking contributor PRs
- all workflows should run automatically on PR pushes
